title.hi: रहस्यमयी पुरातात्विक स्थल (पहचानिए मैं कौन हूँ?)

instruction.en: Read the empirical clue and tap 'Reveal Target' to test active recall.
instruction.hi: दिए गए पुरातात्विक संकेतों को पढ़ें और उत्तर देखने हेतु 'Reveal Target' पर टैप करें।
instruction.hinglish: Clues padho aur check karo ki bina option dekhe site yaad aati hai ya nahi.

cards.clue_1: Main Kashmir valley mein sthit hoon. Mere yahan extreme thand se bachne ke liye subterranean pit-dwellings bani thin aur ek anokhi custom mein master ke sath pet dog ko ek hi grave pit mein dafnaya gaya tha[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Burzahom (Kashmir)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Balochistan ke Kachi Plain mein Bolan River ke paas hoon. Subcontinent mein c. 7000 BC se wheat aur barley farming, mud-brick granaries aur continuous Harappan sequence mere paas hai[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Mehrgarh (Balochistan)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Uttar Pradesh ki Belan Valley mein hoon. Mere yahan cord-impressed pottery ke andar world ki earliest rice (dhaan) cultivation ke grains embedded mile hain[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Koldihwa & Mahagara (UP)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Bihar ke Saran district mein Ganga kinare hoon. Pure subcontinent mein deer antlers aur animal bones se bane hundreds of sophisticated Neolithic tools ke liye meri pehchan hai[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Chirand (Bihar)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Rajasthan ki Kothari river par situated hoon. Main India ka sabse bada Mesolithic settlement hoon jahan massive microlithic layers aur early animal domestication ke proof mile[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Bagor (Rajasthan)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Madhya Pradesh ke Hoshangabad mein hoon. Mesolithic era mein cattle aur sheep-goat domestication ka earliest archaeological proof mere rock shelter complex se mila[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Adamgarh (Madhya Pradesh)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Uttar Pradesh ke Pratapgarh district mein hoon. Mere yahan planned human burials, double skeletons (joint male-female) aur shell necklace ornaments mile hain[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Sarai Nahar Rai & Mahadaha (UP)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Karnataka ke Raichur belt mein hoon. Neolithic pastoral communities ke cattle kraals mein gobar (cow dung) ke periodic ritual burnings se bane colossal 'Ash Mounds' meri pehchan hain[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Piklihal (Karnataka)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Andhra Pradesh ki limestone caves hoon. Upper Palaeolithic human band dwara controlled indoor fire use karne ka stratified ash layers mere yahan excavated hua[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Kurnool Caves (Andhra Pradesh)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Main Tamil Nadu ke Kortallayar basin mein hoon. South Asia ke sabse purane Lower Palaeolithic Acheulian bifacial stone hand-axes mere yahan se excavate hue[cite: 3].
cards.answer: Attirampakkam (Tamil Nadu)[cite: 3]

title.hi: स्थल एवं विशिष्ट पुरातात्विक साक्ष्य मिलान
title.hinglish: Site to Diagnostic Artifact Fast Match

instruction.en: Pair each excavated archaeological site directly with its signature discovery.
instruction.hi: प्रत्येक स्थल को उसकी विशिष्ट खोज के साथ मानसिक रूप से सुमेलित करें।
instruction.hinglish: Har site ko uski exact finding ke sath match karke tap karo.

cards.clue_1: Sohgaura (Gorakhpur, UP) ➔ Kis cheez ka record deta hai?
cards.answer: Pre-Ashokan Brahmi record of Famine Relief Granaries

cards.clue_1: Junagarh Rock Inscription (Rudradaman I) ➔ Linguistic & engineering importance?
cards.answer: First long inscription in chaste classical Sanskrit & Sudarshana Lake repair without extra tax

cards.clue_1: Prayag Prashasti (Harisena) ➔ Kis ruler aur language se associated hai?
cards.answer: Samudragupta; Sanskrit language & Brahmi script in Champu style

cards.clue_1: Aihole Inscription (Ravikirti)[cite: 2] ➔ Military encounter recorded?
cards.answer: Pulakesin II defeating Emperor Harshavardhana on Narmada[cite: 2]

cards.clue_1: Hathigumpha Inscription (Udayagiri)[cite: 2] ➔ Language, script aur ruler?
cards.answer: King Kharavela of Kalinga; Prakrit language & Brahmi script[cite: 2]

cards.clue_1: Langhnaj (Mehsana, Gujarat)[cite: 3] ➔ Major faunal and skeletal finding?
cards.answer: 14 Human Skeletons, wild rhinoceros bones & geometric microliths[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Bhimbetka (Raisen, MP)[cite: 2, 3] ➔ Evolutionary artistic spectrum?
cards.answer: Continuous rock art sequence: Upper Palaeolithic beasts to Mesolithic communal dance[cite: 2, 3]

cards.clue_1: Deogarh (Lalitpur, UP)[cite: 2] ➔ Architectural milestone?
cards.answer: Dashavatara Temple; classical Gupta Nagara stone temple architecture[cite: 2]

instruction.en: Mentally arrange these archaeological horizons in strict historical order.
instruction.hi: इन्हें सही ऐतिहासिक कालक्रम में व्यवस्थित करें।
instruction.hinglish: Inko shuru se end tak correct sequence mein arrange karo.

cards.clue_1: Ceramic Pottery Evolution Sequence: NBPW, OCP, PGW[cite: 2] ➔ Correct order?
cards.answer: 1. OCP (Copper Hoard/Early Vedic) ➔ 2. PGW (Later Vedic Iron Age) ➔ 3. NBPW (Mahajanapada/Mauryan Second Urbanization)[cite: 2]

cards.clue_1: Lithic Technology Progression: Microliths, Polished Celts, Core Hand-Axes, Blade-Burins[cite: 3] ➔ Correct order?
cards.answer: 1. Core Hand-Axes (Lower Pal) ➔ 2. Flake Scrapers (Middle Pal) ➔ 3. Blade-Burins (Upper Pal) ➔ 4. Microliths (Mesolithic) ➔ 5. Polished Celts (Neolithic)[cite: 3]

cards.clue_1: Foreign Travelers Arrival Sequence: Hiuen-Tsang, Megasthenes, Al-Biruni, Fa-Hien, I-Tsing[cite: 2] ➔ Correct order?
cards.answer: 1. Megasthenes (c. 300 BC) ➔ 2. Fa-Hien (c. 400 AD) ➔ 3. Hiuen-Tsang (c. 630 AD) ➔ 4. I-Tsing (c. 671 AD) ➔ 5. Al-Biruni (11th Century AD)[cite: 2]

cards.clue_1: Monetary Currency Evolution: Kushan Gold, Indo-Greek Portrait Coins, Later Gupta Debased Gold, Punch-Marked Silver[cite: 2] ➔ Correct order?
cards.answer: 1. Punch-Marked Silver (c. 6th c. BC) ➔ 2. Indo-Greek Portrait Coins (c. 2nd c. BC) ➔ 3. Kushan High-Purity Gold (c. 1st c. AD) ➔ 4. Classical Gupta Gold ➔ 5. Later Gupta Debased Gold[cite: 2]
